data.name: Ashes of Ambition
data.detailed_description:
Start From Zero, Rise to the Top.

You are a rogue former Special Forces operator trapped behind enemy lines, where the price of freedom is the elimination of a key target. Survival is just the beginning; every step you take is a preparation for the ultimate mission. Find your way in a massive open world where nothing is easy. Provide your resources, repair disabled systems, and build the infrastructure required to fund your war. From managing energy grids to equipment trade, every decision shapes your own path.

  • ⚡ Fund Your Mission (Craft and Energy): You need to unlock advanced equipment and vehicles required to reach your ultimate goal. For this, gather resources, repair disabled systems, and build your own infrastructure by generating energy. Managing energy grids and producing the required technology (craft) is the only way to lead you to victory.
  • 🔫 Survival Dynamics: You must constantly monitor basic needs such as hunger and thirst. Every death has a price.
  • 🎯 Goal-Oriented Progression: Fulfill the main mission given to you to regain your freedom. Manage your resources.
  • 🗺️ Open World and Production: Drive your car on a massive map, hunt deer in the wild, cut trees, and gather minerals. Build your base, produce electricity, and loot resources.

data.short_description: Start from Zero, Rise to the Top. As a fugitive ex-Special Forces op, your freedom depends on one task: eliminating a key target. Build an energy empire to fund your ops, manage resources, craft gear, and explore. Survival is just the beginning; forge your path in high-stakes tactical missions.

content_descriptors.notes: "This game contains frequent violence and realistic combat scenarios involving firearms. Players will engage in tactical battles where blood effects and injury animations are visible. The game focuses on a survival atmosphere in a hostile environment, featuring intense combat encounters, but it does not contain any sexual content or nudity."
